shortDescription: Katy, Texas, Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CW Petroleum Corp (OTCQB: CWPE) (the “Company” or “CWPE”), a leading provider of Specialty Renewable and Hydrocarbon Motor Fuels, today announces to its investors and future investors Financial Results for the Six Months Ended June 30, 2026.Key Financ…

children: ) (the “Company” or “CWPE”), a leading provider of Specialty Renewable and Hydrocarbon Motor Fuels, today announces to its investors and future investors Financial Results for the Six Months Ended June 30, 2026.
Key Financial Highlights for the Six Months Ended June 30, 2026, Compared to the Prior-Year Period:
2026 Revenues of $2.5 Million vs 2025 Revenues of $3.7 Million
2026 Net Income (loss) of ($121,061) vs 2025 Net Income of $1,713
2026 Average Per Gallon Price of $4.32 vs 2025 Average Per Gallon Price of $3.53
2026 Total Gallon Sales of 559,476 vs 2025 Total Gallon Sales of 1,066,921

The Company continues to seek growth capital from private and public sources to grow its motor fuel business nationwide. If you are an investment bank or private investor and would like to invest in the Company, please contact us as per the email below to discuss investment options, rules, and disclosures related to an investment.
Additional accurate information about the Company can be found on the OTC Markets website at the following links and on the EDGAR filing website provided by the Securities and Exchange Commission:
visit our website at cwpetroleumcorp.com, email: investor@cwpetroleumcorp.com , or call 281-817-8099

CW Petroleum Corp, a Texas corporation, was founded by Christopher Williams and began operations in 2011. CW Petroleum Corp, a Wyoming corporation, was incorporated in April 2018 and has acquired the Texas corporation as a wholly-owned subsidiary. CW Petroleum Corp supplies and distributes Biodiesel, Biodiesel Blends, Renewable Gasoline, and NO ETHANOL High Octane (91, 92, 93) On-Road Reformulated Gasoline to distributors, convenience stores, marinas, and end-users.
